fieldNotes.location: UNRESOLVED. This is the vaguest of the SalSon roster entries — not even a city is pinned down; the roster city field is literally 'Inland Empire (Riverside/San Bernardino area)'. The Inland Empire is named only as a SalSon California market in the Aug-2024 merger / footprint coverage (Transport Topics: 'Bakersfield, Inland Empire, Long Beach and Oakland, Calif.'). No specific city, street address, building, or coordinates have ever been published. SalSon's own indeed.com locations page lists no Inland Empire city; salson.com names no IE address. Searches against the merged companies (incl. TriPack Logistics) and against the standard IE warehouse submarkets (Fontana, Mira Loma, Bloomington, Jurupa Valley, Riverside, San Bernardino, Ontario) returned no confirmable SalSon facility.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Set Urban as a market-level default (the Inland Empire is a dense warehouse-corridor metro); not verified against a specific building.
fieldNotes.all: No coordinates, no perimeter, no imagery. Every classification value is a schema-required placeholder, NOT an observation. Site flagged for human review or for a direct address request to SalSon (973-986-0200 / sales@salson.com). Note: the under-construction Compton CA build (roster idx 4) is sometimes described as SalSon's Southern California intermodal/transload hub and may functionally be what 'Inland Empire' refers to in some sources; if so this entry could be a duplicate of idx 4 — recommend the run owner reconcile.
